_comment: Codex Micro -> any GUI agent app. Keys map to VERBS; each target defines how a verb is performed in that app. Verb values are wtype chords, or focus:<appid>, or shell:<cmd>. null means NOT YET KNOWN — the daemon logs it as unresolved rather than guessing, because a key that does the wrong thing in the wrong app is worse than one that does nothing. Physical layout confirmed 2026-08-28: AG00-AG05 top row L-R, ACT06-ACT12 bottom row L-R, ACT11 ignored (the wide mic cap fires ACT10+ACT11 together).
